name: @pulseboard/app
description: Static SvelteKit app for Pulseboard, built for Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && vite build && npm test
scripts.test: tsx --test test/css-variables.test.ts test/static-routes.test.ts test/api-client.test.ts test/preview-catalog.test.ts test/member-session.test.ts
